## Shared Keybinds

| Key | Action | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>&lt;Esc&gt;</code> | [<code>close</code>](../../shared/yazi/keymap.toml#L25) | Cancel input<br><code>input; prepend_keymap</code> |
| <code>&lt;Esc&gt;</code> | [<code>plugin lua.smart-esc</code>](../../shared/yazi/keymap.toml#L5) | Cancel visual mode, selection, filter, find or search, otherwise quit<br><code>mgr; prepend_keymap</code> |
| <code>g → a</code> | [<code>cd ~/dotfiles</code>](../../shared/yazi/keymap.toml#L15) | Go to ~/dotfiles<br><code>mgr; prepend_keymap</code> |
| <code>g → d</code> | [<code>cd ~/Documents</code>](../../shared/yazi/keymap.toml#L20) | Go to ~/Documents<br><code>mgr; prepend_keymap</code> |
| <code>g → p</code> | [<code>cd ~/projects</code>](../../shared/yazi/keymap.toml#L10) | Go to ~/projects<br><code>mgr; prepend_keymap</code> |
